note: Plan 0026, R13: the beauty pass of the Vũng Tàu world, for each hour of the day (January). scripts/look/grading.gd gives the values between two hours, and VungTau.update_time() applies them after the light of the sun and the sky. exposure multiplies the exposure of the light code; saturation and contrast are the color adjustment; sun_warmth mixes the sun color to sun_color (the golden hour: warm, not orange); sky_mix mixes the top and the horizon of the sky to sky_top and sky_horizon; ambient_mix mixes the ambient light to ambient_color (the shade of the golden hour takes the blue of the sky: on the presets with no SDFGI, the warm ambient light of the twilight made the whole frame orange); glow is the bloom; haze is the fog density with haze_color. The part of a renderer (mobile: Low on a phone and the Mobile renderer of the workspace; forward_plus: the computer presets) adds its values to the values of the hour, and the values of its own hours (a value that an hour does not give is 0; out of its hours, 0). The golden hour of January is 16:30 to 17:45 (sunset at about 17:50). All values are builder values from the photos of section 3; I approve them with the shots of PT-72. sea_mix mixes the colors of the sea (shaders/water.gdshader: deep_color and shallow_color) to sea_deep and sea_shallow: the water of Bãi Trước is green grey, not cyan (report 0026, D-0026-06; four photos of 2014 to 2021, the mean of the water #677985). sea_roughness and sea_specular are the gloss of the water with the part sea_mix: a glossy water (0.06 and 0.6) is the color of the sky at a low angle.

mobile.note: The Mobile renderer has no SDFGI: in the golden hour the sunlit sand and the walk were orange on Low (phase 4). From 16:30 to 17:45 it takes 0.12 from the saturation and 0.06 from the exposure, as the part forward_plus does all day.
